simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חוּם (H2345) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חוּם (chûwm) means sunburnt or swarthy (blackish) First listed occurrence: Gen 30 32.

definitions.full: H2345. chum חוּם adjective darkened, dark brown or black , only of colour of sheep (in Genesis 30, J); — בכשׂבים וכלשֶֿׂהחֿוּם Gen 30:32 , בכ ׳וְחוּם 30:33 , 35 , בְּצאֹן וכלחֿוּם 30:40 (clause probably interpolated Ol Hup De We Di). חוֺמָה see below חמה .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to be warm, i.e. (by implication)
